# Skye Real World-Site Full Room Pack v3

This package includes all current REAL room/environment builds, excluding the earlier abstract no-go prototypes.

Included:
1. `index.html` — launcher
2. `barbershop_chair_room_world.html`
3. `tattoo_studio_ink_room.html`
4. `med_spa_glow_room.html`
5. `gym_training_floor_world.html`

Standard:
- Actual environment, not abstract card boards
- Central physical object anchor
- Left/right wall content as real scene surfaces
- Clickable room hotspots
- Scroll-camera movement
- Drag-to-pan room
- Ctrl-wheel zoom
- Drawer detail/conversion panels
- GSAP enhancement where available, native fallback otherwise

This is the current Skye World-Site Real Room lane.
